name: WNBA_R1A_INPUT_AUDIT_V1

scope.target_tip_cutoff_rule: Every target-game feature must be derivable only from information known strictly before that target game's scheduled/actual pregame cutoff.

SPORTS_ONLY_V1.reason: Most statistical/context features are point-in-time reconstructible, but the repository's current injury source is a current-state ESPN scrape rather than a certified timestamped 2021-2025 archive, and historical manual-adjustment logs were not found.

CURRENT_65_35_V1.reason: The 65/35 control additionally requires timestamped pregame market probabilities and shares the unresolved injury/manual-state requirements.

season_to_date_stats.temporal_cutoff: Use only games finalized strictly before the target-game pregame cutoff; target game is excluded.
season_to_date_stats.missingness_policy: No season-end/current snapshot may be substituted backward. Insufficient prior games must be represented explicitly under a preregistered cold-start rule before outcomes are opened.
season_to_date_stats.anti_leakage_rule: Target final score and any game completed after target tip are forbidden. Prior-game results are permitted only because they were knowable before target tip.

recent_stats.temporal_cutoff: Recompute the same rolling recent window using only finalized games strictly before target tip.
recent_stats.missingness_policy: Do not backfill with future games; insufficient history must use an outcome-blind preregistered rule.
recent_stats.anti_leakage_rule: No target-game or future-game statistics may enter the recent block.

schedule_context.temporal_cutoff: Derive from the schedule and completed games known before target tip.
schedule_context.missingness_policy: Unknown/cancelled/postponed schedule states must be explicit; no inference from later game completion order.
schedule_context.anti_leakage_rule: Future schedule changes or post-tip game status cannot rewrite the pregame state.

sos.temporal_cutoff: Recompute opponent strength as of target tip, with each opponent state itself restricted to information available before target tip.
sos.missingness_policy: Current-season/final-season SOS is not an allowed historical substitute.
sos.anti_leakage_rule: No opponent end-of-season or future performance may be projected backward into an earlier target game.

travel.temporal_cutoff: Distance is deterministic from the target fixture and preceding location known pregame.
travel.missingness_policy: Team/venue coordinate mapping must be versioned by season; current expansion/venue assumptions cannot be silently applied backward.
travel.anti_leakage_rule: Use season-correct team identity, home venue and prior location only.

injuries.temporal_cutoff: Would require a timestamped injury/availability snapshot known before each target tip.
injuries.missingness_policy: UNKNOWN_IS_NOT_ZERO. Do not zero-fill, backfill from a later report, infer from target-game participation, or use status learned after tip.
injuries.anti_leakage_rule: Future injury knowledge, target-game box-score participation, and post-tip availability updates are forbidden.
injuries.repository_evidence: Current implementation retrieves current ESPN WNBA injury state. Repository searches did not identify a certified point-in-time 2021-2025 injury snapshot/archive.

manual_adjustment.temporal_cutoff: Would require a timestamped record of the operator-visible state before target tip.
manual_adjustment.missingness_policy: Do not assume zero and label the result an exact production replay. A separate preregistered research candidate may explicitly omit manual adjustments before outcomes are opened.
manual_adjustment.anti_leakage_rule: No reconstruction from the target result or later operator knowledge.

market.temporal_cutoff: For CURRENT_65_35_V1 control only, market probability must be timestamped pregame.
market.missingness_policy: Never impute market data into SPORTS_ONLY_V1; control rows with missing certified pregame price require explicit exclusion/handling fixed before outcomes.
market.anti_leakage_rule: Closing/post-tip/final-result-derived prices cannot be substituted for the frozen pregame control input.

anti_leakage_invariants: Target outcomes remain unopened during R1A.
The target game's final score, box score and target-derived participation cannot be used to construct its features.
Prior-game outcomes are valid historical feature inputs only when those games were final before the target cutoff.
No season-end aggregate may be used backward unless it can be reconstructed from the pre-target prefix only.
Unknown historical injury state cannot be treated as healthy/zero adjustment.
No coefficient, threshold, calibration, feature rule or routing change may be selected after target outcomes are opened.
requirements_to_upgrade_pass: Provide and freeze a complete timestamped historical WNBA injury/availability archive with coverage adequate for the intended 2021-2025 cohort, plus a deterministic pre-tip selection rule.

If exact product replay is claimed, provide timestamped historical manual-adjustment/override logs or explicitly redefine the claim as a separately preregistered research candidate before outcomes are opened.
Implement season/date/as-of reconstruction for statistics, recent form, schedule context, SOS and travel and freeze its source-row digest before opening target outcomes.
For CURRENT_65_35_V1 control, separately certify timestamped pregame market inputs.
allowed_next_actions: Search for or ingest a timestamped historical injury archive and audit its temporal coverage without opening target outcomes.
Build the point-in-time historical feature constructor for the reconstructible groups and freeze deterministic missingness rules.
Preregister a distinct injury-neutral research candidate such as SPORTS_ONLY_NO_INJURY_V1 before any target outcomes are opened, if exact historical injury data cannot be certified.
Use a narrower period with certified injury coverage only as secondary validation; it does not silently replace the primary 2021-2025 objective.
prohibited_next_actions: Open target outcomes while R1A remains CONDITIONAL.
Set missing historical injury adjustment to zero and call it exact SPORTS_ONLY_V1 replay.
Infer injuries from target-game minutes, box scores, recaps or later reports.
Use current/final-season statistics or SOS as historical pregame state.
Tune coefficients, thresholds, calibration, candidate definition or exclusion rules after observing target outcomes.

closure.primary_blocker: No certified timestamped historical WNBA injury/availability archive found in the current repository/source chain for 2021-2025.
closure.secondary_exact_replay_blocker: No timestamped historical manual-adjustment/override log was found.
